📸🍂 Fall Memories | Polaroid Coloring Effect I wanted this Cozy Collection page to feel like little fall memories captured on film, so I turned two parts of the coloring page into overlapping Polaroids! 🥹✨ I measured and traced the Polaroid frames first, outlined them with an Ohuhu water-based fineliner, then used my Gelly Roll 10 to white out the original line art where the frames overlap. I colored everything outside the photos in grayscale so the Polaroids would really look like they were layered on top of the page. Then came the fun part — COLOR. 🌈 I used only the 48 colors from the Coco Wyo × Ohuhu collab set for both Polaroids, with a warm sunset palette for one and brighter blues, greens, pinks and yellows for the other. 📸 I love how much the colorful photos pop against the black-and-white background! Would you try this Polaroid effect on a coloring page? 🍂✨ #coloring #coloringbook #coloringtutorial #cocowyo #ohuhumarkers
